function.arguments: {"observation": "`species` and `island` are strongly associated (up to 64% departure from the overall rate).", "implication": "The groups (species) are not comparable because they are systematically linked to `island`. A raw comparison of mean flipper length by species could be confounded by island — the observed difference might partly reflect the island effect, not the species effect. To get a valid estimate of the species effect, we must either stratify by island, standardise, or model the confounding. Since the question asks for the species with the highest mean flipper length across all penguins, and island is a confounder, we must adjust for it."}
function.name: note_finding
